content: Good morning, Sunrise Family Clinic, Ana speaking. How may I help you today?
Good morning, Ana. My name is Maria Garcia, and I'd like to book an appointment with Doctor Lopez this week.
We have openings with Dr. Lopez on Monday at nine thirty or ten in the morning. Which would you prefer?
I think Monday at nine thirty would work for me.
Just to confirm: Dr. Lopez on Monday at nine thirty, for Maria Garcia. Shall I book that for you?
Yes, please book that for me.
Your appointment with Dr. Lopez on Monday at nine thirty has been confirmed. Have a great day!
Thank you, Ana. Have a great day too!
